get_quotation: get a price quotation for a cab ride between two locations with a specific service type
list_rides: list all available cab rides between two locations across all service types
order_ride: order a cab ride and book it with start location, end location, and service type
user_cancel_ride: cancel the current on-going cab ride and mark it as cancelled in history
get_current_ride_status: check the current status and delay of an on-going cab ride
